legend: Alice, a talented pianist, just composed a perfect melody! A melody is a sequence of n$$$n$$$ notes a1,a2,...,an$$$a_1, a_2, ..., a_n$$$, represented as integers. This melody is cyclic, meaning that the n$$$n$$$th note is adjacent to the first note. Further, a perfect melody is one such that each pair of adjacent notes different in value by exactly 1$$$1$$$. (Formally, |ai−a(imodn)+1|=1$$$|a_i - a_{(i \bmod n) + 1}| = 1$$$ for all i∈{1,2,...,n}$$$i \in \{1, 2, ..., n\}$$$)

Alice was just about to play the melody when Bob showed up and scrambled all the notes! Given an arbitrary ordering of the notes, help Alice determine the number of perfect melodies she can form by rearranging the notes. Two rearrangements are considered unique if for some i$$$i$$$, the i$$$i$$$-th element in the original ordering ends up in different positions between the two rearrangements.
input: The first line of input will contain n$$$n$$$ (2≤n≤2⋅105$$$2 \leq n \leq 2 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the number of notes in the melody.
The next line of input will contain n$$$n$$$ space-separated integers a1,a2,...,an$$$a_1, a_2, ..., a_n$$$ (1≤ai≤106$$$1 \leq a_i \leq 10^6$$$) — the (unordered) sequence of notes in the melody.
output: Output a single integer, representing the number of ways that the notes can be arranged into a perfect melody. Since this number may be very large, output it modulo 998244353$$$998244353$$$.

legend.ai: Alice 是一位才华横溢的钢琴家，她刚刚创作了一首完美的旋律！旋律是由 n$$$n$$$ 个音符 a1,a2,...,an$$$a_1, a_2, ..., a_n$$$ 组成的序列，用整数表示。这首旋律是循环的，也就是说，第 n$$$n$$$ 个音符与第一个音符相邻。此外，完美旋律需要满足每一对相邻音符的数值之差的绝对值恰好为 1$$$1$$$。(形式化地，对于所有 i∈{1,2,...,n}$$$i \in \{1, 2, ..., n\}$$$，都有 |ai−a(imodn)+1|=1$$$|a_i - a_{(i \bmod n) + 1}| = 1$$$。)
Alice 正准备演奏这首旋律时，Bob 出现并打乱了所有音符！给定这些音符的任意排列，请帮助 Alice 确定通过重新排列这些音符可以组成多少首完美旋律。如果对于某个 i$$$i$$$，原排列中的第 i$$$i$$$ 个元素在两种重新排列中的最终位置不同，则认为这两种重新排列是不同的。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$(2≤n≤2⋅105$$$2 \leq n \leq 2 \cdot 10^5$$$)，表示旋律中的音符数量。
输入的下一行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个以空格分隔的整数 a1,a2,...,an$$$a_1, a_2, ..., a_n$$$ (1≤ai≤106$$$1 \leq a_i \leq 10^6$$$) — 旋律中音符的(无序)序列。

output.ai: 输出一个整数，表示将这些音符排列成完美旋律的方案数。由于这个数可能很大，请输出它对 998244353$$$998244353$$$ 取模的结果。
